$description: Design tokens for zorya.website and the Zorya app. Two themes: noc (dark, default) and dzien (light). Flat colour only — no gradients, no shadows, square corners. Every text/ground pair listed in contrast.json passes WCAG AA; most pass AAA.

night.usage: The night sky. Dark-theme page ground; text on every bright status fill; the light theme's ink.

night-raised.usage: Dark-theme cards, sheets, the header bar.

night-line.usage: Dark-theme decorative rules and dividers (1.47:1 — never carries meaning).

night-line-strong.usage: Dark-theme borders that carry meaning: inputs, the horizon rule, the quiet (cisza) ring. 3.31:1 on night.

ivory.usage: The morning star's white. Dark-theme primary text and the horizon rule in the mark. 16.1:1 on night.

ash.usage: Dark-theme secondary text: timestamps, source names, helper text. 8.6:1 on night.

fog-line.usage: Light-theme decorative rules (1.32:1 — never carries meaning).

fog-line-strong.usage: Light-theme borders that carry meaning. 3.22:1 on fog.

dawn.usage: Dawn gold — the brand accent and the star's colour. Level obserwacja (watch). Dark theme only, as text (10.3:1 on night) or as a fill with night text; on light grounds use dawn-deep.

dawn-deep.usage: Dawn gold darkened for text and icons on light grounds (6.2:1 on fog).

ember.usage: Ember — level ostrzezenie (warning). Text on dark grounds (6.7:1 on night); fill with night text everywhere.

ember-deep.usage: Ember for text and icons on light grounds (5.7:1 on fog).

alarm.usage: Alarm red. Level alarm. Text on dark grounds (6.3:1 on night); the fill of an inverted alarm card, with night text (6.3:1).

alarm-deep.usage: Alarm red for text and icons on light grounds (5.7:1 on fog).

calm.usage: Calm sky blue — level odwolanie (all clear) and links on dark grounds (10.3:1 on night). Blue, not green, so alarm and all-clear never rely on a red/green hue difference.

calm-deep.usage: Calm blue for text, icons and links on light grounds (6.5:1 on fog).

semantic.$description: Use these in UI. They flip with the theme; the core values above do not.

bg-raised.usage: Cards, sheets, the app header, inputs.

line-strong.usage: Borders that mean something: inputs, the horizon rule, chips, the cisza ring. ≥3:1 in both themes.

text-2.usage: Secondary text: timestamps, sources, helper copy.

on-status.usage: Text and icons on a status fill: night on the bright dark-theme fills, ivory on the deep light-theme fills. Never pure white.

link.usage: Link text; the underline is link-underline.

focus.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px. Never removed.

status-cisza.usage: Level cisza (quiet): the hollow star and its label. Text colour; there is no cisza fill.

fill-obserwacja.usage: Filled badge/star for obserwacja; text on it is on-status. Light theme uses the deep colour so the fill itself reads ≥3:1 on fog.

fill-ostrzezenie.usage: Filled badge/star for ostrzezenie; text on it is on-status.

fill-alarm.usage: The inverted alarm card and the alarm star; text on it is on-status.

fill-odwolanie.usage: Filled badge/star for odwolanie; text on it is on-status.

map-land.usage: Map: land (same as page ground — the map is not a picture, it is the page).

map-roads.usage: Map: roads and rail, decorative weight.

map-area-alpha.usage: Opacity of an event's area polygon fill (status colour); its outline is the status colour at 1.5px, solid.

ui.usage: Everything: interface, headings, the wordmark, body copy on the website. Variable, weights 200–800; use 400, 500, 700, 800.

mono.value: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace
mono.usage: Timestamps, coordinates, frequencies, signal IDs, the descriptor line under the wordmark. Weight 500.

files.$note: Variable fonts, SIL OFL 1.1. latin-ext carries the Polish glyphs (ą ć ę ł ń ś ź ż) — load both subsets, see tokens.css.

body.usage: Running text. Never below 16px on screen.

body-strong.usage: Emphasis, the level word in an alert line.

small.usage: Helper text, captions, legend. Minimum size in the app.

label.usage: Uppercase labels: level badges, section eyebrows, chips. Always uppercase.

mono.usage: Timestamps (24h, ISO date), coordinates, frequencies, IDs. Tabular by nature.

mono-small.usage: Timestamps inside cards and the timeline.

wordmark.usage: ZORYA in caps. Use the SVG files; live type only in the app header at 18px.

space.$description: 4px base. Use the steps; do not invent 10px or 18px.

app-column.usage: Max width of the app's single column (640px); the map is full-bleed.

site-column.usage: Max width of the website content (1152px).

text-measure.usage: Max width of running text on the website.

touch-target.usage: Minimum tap target; list rows are at least 56px.

header.usage: App header height; the horizon rule is its bottom edge.

star-inline.usage: The status star inline in a list row.

star-header.usage: The status star in the header (current level).

star-hero.usage: The status star on the home status block.

logo-header.usage: Cap height of the wordmark in the website header (lockup ≈ 148px wide).

logo-min.usage: Smallest mark on screen (favicon variant below 24px).

0.usage: Everything: buttons, cards, inputs, chips, the map legend. Square corners are the brand.

full.usage: Only the star (a circle) and the dot in a toggle.

horizon.usage: The horizon rule under the app header and on the home status block; doubles (two 2px rules, 2px apart) at level ostrzezenie and above.

map-outline.usage: Outline of an event area on the map.

none.usage: There are no shadows. Elevation is a border and a raised ground.

star-breath.usage: The alarm star fades between 100% and 60% opacity, 2s, ease-in-out, only at level alarm and only while unread. Off under prefers-reduced-motion — then the star stays solid and the label carries it.

levels.$description: The five horizon levels. Word first, then shape, then colour — a level is never conveyed by colour alone.

cisza.shape: hollow star (ring, 2px line-strong) over a single horizon
cisza.usage: No active event in the selected areas. All sources reporting.

obserwacja.shape: filled star over a single horizon
obserwacja.usage: One signal, or an official notice with no local confirmation. Read it; do nothing yet.

ostrzezenie.shape: filled star over a double horizon
ostrzezenie.usage: Two independent sources agree, or an official warning for your area. Prepare.

alarm.shape: filled star over a double horizon, card inverted (fill-alarm, on-status text)
alarm.usage: Official alarm, or siren plus a second source. Act now. Bypasses quiet hours.

odwolanie.shape: filled star over a single horizon
odwolanie.usage: An event was cancelled or expired. Shown for 60 minutes, then the horizon returns to cisza.

confidence.$description: How sure the fusion is. Encoded by the rule under the item, like a certainty ladder — never by colour.

potwierdzone.meaning: At least two independent sources, one of them official or a sensor.

prawdopodobne.meaning: Two sources of the same kind, or one official source.

pojedynczy.meaning: One source. Below the horizon in the feed.

niezweryfikowane.meaning: A user report nobody has confirmed. Below the horizon, never pushed.
